_notes: One entry per employer to watch. type: renewable | conservation | consulting | other. focus 'mixed' adds a no-fossil-fuels caution to every job. region 'Caribbean' skips the remote check. ats 'auto' means the crawler works out the hiring system from the careers page. Add "skip": "reason" to pause a company.

companies.name: 174 Power Global
companies.about: Develops, builds, and runs utility-scale solar and battery storage projects in North America. It is an affiliate of Hanwha Group, a large South Korean conglomerate.

companies.name: Plus Power

companies.name: Transect

companies.name: National Audubon Society
companies.about: Nonprofit that protects birds and the places they need, with science, policy, and on-the-ground conservation across the Americas. Has a large Florida program.

companies.name: Smithsonian Institution

companies.name: Renewable Energy Wildlife Institute

companies.name: The Nature Conservancy

companies.name: American Bird Conservancy

companies.name: Bat Conservation International

companies.name: Defenders of Wildlife

companies.name: American Farmland Trust

companies.name: National Wildlife Federation
companies.about: Large wildlife conservation nonprofit with regional programs across the US.

companies.name: Mass Audubon

companies.name: Atwell

companies.name: SWCA Environmental Consultants

companies.name: Dudek

companies.name: Conservation International

companies.name: Loggerhead Marinelife Center
